groups.example: The groups page of a manager or the superadmin: search by name, create a group, edit its name, its members and its additional roles in one form, searching the users and the additional roles of the organization, and delete groups, as far as the backend allows each row. A superadmin sees one folder per organization, a search at the root spans all of them and is the only list with the organization column, and a group created inside a folder comes with its organization chosen. The demo answers from fixed data, so a change is confirmed but the list stays as it was.
